أتناسق (form VI)
# أَتَنَاسَقُ (ʔatanāsaqu) /ʔa.ta.naː.sa.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاسَقَ (tanāsaqa)
# أَتَنَاسَقَ (ʔatanāsaqa) /ʔa.ta.naː.sa.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاسَقَ (tanāsaqa)
# أَتَنَاسَقْ (ʔatanāsaq) /ʔa.ta.naː.saq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاسَقَ (tanāsaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
